name: a-priori convergence predictions vs observed rates (Professor Rabczuk, 27 Nov)
status: rules and expectations frozen BEFORE any comparison was computed

theory.MMS (smooth manufactured solution), degr: L2 error O(h^(p+1)), H1 error O(h^p) [Ciarlet 1978, Thm 3.2.2]
theory.energy-norm error, uniform h, corner exp: O(h^min(p, lam)) [Strang & Fix 1973 Ch. 8; Babuska & Kellogg 1979]
theory.strain energy (global): error = energy-norm error squared: order 2 min(p, lam); 'equal' prediction
theory.linear functional (point displacement, s: duality: order >= 2 min(p, lam) (primal x dual; faster if the singular coefficients are small); 'lower bound'
theory.pointwise stress at a corner with lam <: unbounded: peak ~ h^(lam - 1) (diverges); 'equal' for the log-log slope
theory.graded meshes (beta-graded toward the co: the smooth orders are restored: energy 2p, functionals >= 2p [Babuska, Kellogg, Pitkaranta 1979; Apel 1999]
theory.no rate-limiting corner: lam = infinity: the smooth orders apply

assumptions_recorded_per_prediction: lam = smallest rate-limiting corner/edge exponent from the meshed boundary (singularity.py)
linear elasticity; for neo-Hookean the linearized exponents are a HYPOTHESIS
3D extruded sections: edge exponents only, vertex singularities not analysed (hypothesis)
h = measured element size of the ladder
observed order: least squares over the finest three levels of the uniform Q2 ladder (Richardson for three levels)

comparison_rule.above prediction (equal mode): classified 'faster than predicted: pre-asymptotic or small singular coefficient' (not a contradiction)
comparison_rule.below prediction by more than 0.3: classified 'slower than predicted: CONTRADICTION, to be diagnosed'

expectations.E1: no stored linear-elastic run has a QoI that is slower than predicted (contradiction)
expectations.E2: global strain energy on corner-limited uniform ladders is 'faster than predicted' more often than 'agrees' (the singular coefficient is small at practical resolution, as seen in the singular-order gate)
expectations.E3: on graded ladders no QoI is slower than the restored order 2p - 0.3 ... except where the grading is limited (records it)
expectations.E4: the MMS code checks on record agree with p+1 / p within the gate tolerance (0.2) for every PASS
